'''Vinyor Tesh''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[third Galactic War]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Tesh was trained in and specialized in maintaining the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]].

==Biography==
Vinyor Tesh was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to a [[Vinyor Tesh's mother|mother]] and [[Vinyor Tesh's father|father]] who were both researchers based on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. At a young age, Tesh's [[Parent/Legends|parents]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Devastation of Manaan|attacked]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the attack, he was noticed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Laotah]], who took him to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be trained as a Jedi at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Codex" />

During Tesh's [[Jedi training/Legends|training]], he specialized in cataloging records and research at the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. Tesh enjoyed this line of work because it helped him feel closer to his parents. Tesh was affected by the [[Sacking of Coruscant#Assault on the Jedi Temple|attack on the Jedi Temple]] when the Imperials invaded Coruscant, being assigned to recover records damaged during the attack.<ref name="Codex" />

Tesh went on to become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and then a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], eventually joining [[Task Force Nova]]<ref name="Codex" /> by [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}. Since Vinyor Tesh appears in The Dark Descent, he must have joined the task force by this date.</ref> When [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], [[Arn Peralun]], and [[Aryn Leneer]] returned from their mission to the old [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]], where they investigated the whereabouts of [[Darth Malgus]], Tesh was one of the Jedi chosen by Master [[Gnost-Dural]] to discuss the next moves in rebuilding the Jedi after the [[war against Zakuul]]. Gnost-Dural chose to invite him, along with [[Tau Idair]] and [[Sal-Deron]] to the gathering because Gnost-Dural believed them to be the Order's most important representatives. Tesh protested Leneer's appearance at the meeting, believing that she no longer had the right to participate in the affairs of the Jedi as a former member, but was rebuffed by Peralun and Gnost-Dural. Gnost-Dural assigned Tesh to comb records of the Jedi Enclave to identify what Malgus took from the ruins.<ref name="Secrets" />

After the meeting, Tesh apologized to the Commander for coming off as cold and leaving a bad first impression. He hoped to develop a working relationship with the Commander.<ref name="Message">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|An apology.|Master Vinyor Tesh}}</ref>

Tesh worked with Peralun to discover that the relic stolen by Darth Malgus from Dantooine was once owned by a certain [[Darth Nul]], but what Malgus intended to do with it and the nature of the relic itself was still unclear to the pair.<ref name="TORWEB">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20211001-0|text=Mission Abstract: Investigate link between Darth Malgus and the planet Elom|int=Mission Abstract: Investigate link between Darth Malgus and the planet Elom}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Tesh was an individual of strong convictions, believing in maintaining the old traditions and protocols of the Jedi Order. He considered himself slow to trust those he was not already familiar with. Tesh valued the security of the Jedi Order and was paranoid of being betrayed from within, believing it necessary to look out for potential spies within Task Force Nova. He believed this because he blamed the decline of the Jedi Order when the [[Eternal Empire]] attacked on help they received from within the Order, and did not want a repeat of this event.<ref name="Message" /> Tesh did not get along with those he considered interested in changing the Jedi to something new and those who challenged Tesh's convictions.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vinyor Tesh appeared in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by the company [[BioWare]]. He was added in the "Secrets of the Enclave" flashpoint. Tesh only appears in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] version of the story.<ref name="Secrets" />
